create_trainer: create a Trainer instance to orchestrate DDP training with Hydra configs for data, model, logging, and checkpointing
run_trainer_training: run the Trainer to execute the full training loop over all epochs with distributed data parallel support
run_trainer_validation: run the Trainer in validation-only mode to evaluate the model on the validation dataset
save_trainer_checkpoint: save a training checkpoint with model state, optimizer state, and scaler state to the configured save directory
chunk_batch_for_accum_steps: chunk a batch into smaller pieces for gradient accumulation across multiple forward-backward passes
